runMode.title: Run Mode
runMode.description: Standard batch run (scrapes & saves to dataset) or continuous Standby HTTP server

repository.title: GitHub Repository
repository.description: Target repository (e.g. pallets/flask, tiangolo/fastapi, or full GitHub URL)

issueNumber.title: Issue Number
issueNumber.description: Specific GitHub issue number to triage and verify (e.g. 5000)

issues.title: Batch Issue Numbers
issues.description: Optional list of issue numbers to triage in batch (up to 20)

githubToken.title: GitHub Personal Access Token
githubToken.description: Optional GitHub PAT for higher API rate limits or private repository access
